data.name: Madih
data.gender_notes: Madih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'dahah', which means to extol or magnify, Madih is a name that conveys the idea of praise or glory. In the Quran, Allah (swt) is referred to as 'Al-Madhih' (The Praiser), emphasizing His infinite ability to praise and glorify Himself and His creation. The name Madih carries the meaning “Praise, Glory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Madih usually hope their child will grow to embody praise, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the grace and beauty of Allah's creation
data.etymology: Madih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praise, Glory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madih total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
